meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容变成可交互的演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要制作带分支导航和演讲者备注的交互式幻灯片
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create interactive slides with branching and speaker notes

howto.what: Claude 会帮你制作一个可交互的幻灯片演示文稿，包含独立的幻灯片、逐步显示的内容片段、可点击的导航热点、分支跳转，以及带演讲者备注的演示模式。输出的是一个可直接在浏览器中运行的演示页面，而不是视频文件。
howto.when: 当你明确要求制作幻灯片、演示文稿、交互式演示，或要求将现有页面转换为幻灯片时触发。如果请求不明确（如只说“演示”），Claude 会先确认你是否需要 HyperFrames 幻灯片。

say.text: 帮我做一个关于我们产品的幻灯片，包含5页。
say.note: Claude 会创建幻灯片框架并询问具体内容。

say.text: 把这个网页转换成可交互的幻灯片。
say.note: Claude 会分析页面结构并生成幻灯片。

say.text: 在第三页添加一个热点，点击后跳转到详细数据页。
say.note: Claude 会在指定幻灯片中插入可点击的交互区域。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you create an interactive slideshow presentation with discrete slides, fragment reveals, clickable hotspots, branching navigation, and presenter mode with speaker notes. The output is a runnable deck in the browser, not a video file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you explicitly ask for a slideshow, presentation, pitch deck, interactive deck, or converting an existing page into a deck. If the request is ambiguous, Claude will confirm before proceeding.

say_en.text: Create a 5-slide pitch deck about our product.
say_en.note: Claude will build the deck structure and ask for content.

say_en.text: Convert this webpage into an interactive slideshow.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the page and generate slides.

say_en.text: Add a hotspot on slide 3 that links to a detailed data page.
say_en.note: Claude will insert a clickable interactive region.
